data.narrative:
Calogena is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Julien Dereux that has raised €100M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 total peers—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies—spanning the nuclear energy sector at seed through Series B stages.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression uses the €100M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement, implying a $200M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Fuse Energy ($200M Series A), Nano Nuclear Energy ($808M Seed), and Valar Atomics ($6.0B Series B)—yields a median valuation of $808M, with a range of $200M to $6.0B.

The triangulated valuation range spans $170M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $504M. This wide dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in peer stage and capital structure within the nuclear energy sector. The peer-median method captures this variance more fully than stage-progression alone. Key uncertainties include Calogena's specific technical maturity relative to the Seed-stage Nano Nuclear comparison and whether capital intensity and time-to-revenue align more closely with earlier or later-stage peers. Validation against deployment timelines and regulatory pathway progress would narrow this range materially.
